notes.title: Announcement of the Multi-language Version Plan for "Rebirth!New Lover“
notes.content:
Dear Players,

With immense sincerity and excitement, we are thrilled to officially announce a major update for "Rebirth!New Lover" – the multi-language versions are about to go live! Deeply acknowledging that the charm of culture transcends borders, we have meticulously prepared this update plan to bring this timeless romance and profound Chinese cultural heritage to gamers worldwide.

We aspire that regardless of where you are, you can seamlessly immerse yourself in this exquisite ancient love story, jointly exploring the unique charm of ancient China.

[Update Highlights]

Multi-language Support: This update specifically adds support for English, Japanese, Korean, French, Russian, and other languages, ensuring that every player can experience the game in their most familiar tongue, feel the love that spans millennia, and appreciate the elegance of ancient style and the richness of Chinese traditional culture. We will promptly release the English version, with subsequent versions following suit.

Cultural Depth Experience: In the newly added multi-language versions, not only will the game dialogue be translated, but the achievement and allusion systems will also be synchronized, deeply integrating cultural backgrounds. Players can delve into the festivities, costume culture, poetry, and songwriting of ancient China while enjoying the game, fostering cultural exchange and understanding.

Optimized Gameplay Experience: To enhance the gaming experience for players globally, we have conducted comprehensive performance optimizations and interface adjustments to ensure smooth gameplay across various devices. We warmly welcome feedback and suggestions from all players, fostering an environment where gamers from different countries can freely share insights, experiences, and build a harmonious and friendly gaming community together.

[Our Expectations]

"Rebirth!New Lover" is not merely a game; it is a cultural journey through time. We sincerely invite players worldwide to join this feast, collectively experiencing the unparalleled elegance of ancient China and co-authoring your legendary tales. Whether you're a fan of ancient culture or seek fresh gaming experiences, there are unexpected surprises awaiting your discovery here.

Let us embark on this romantic adventure transcending national boundaries! We eagerly anticipate meeting and knowing you in the world of "Rebirth!New Lover," sharing an unforgettable journey of ancient love.

May this update bring you a brand-new gaming experience, and we look forward to your participation in scripting more beautiful chapters together!
